name: Yamaha V-Max 1200
engine: 1198 cc liquid-cooled V4, four carbs with V-Boost, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's original muscle V4. Carb diaphragms and the V-Boost servo are the usual jobs.

add.title: Check the V-Boost system
add.instructions: With the key on, check that the V-Boost servo cycles and the butterflies between the carb pairs open and close freely. Clean and lube the linkage.
add.reason: A stuck V-Boost takes away the top-end rush or makes the bike run badly.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Carb diaphragms
known.what: Cracked carb diaphragms cause rough idle and hesitation.
